versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the claude-api skill.
- Provides unified, OpenAI-compatible API access to all Claude models (Opus, Sonnet, Haiku) with zero markup.
- Uses a single SkillBoss API key for 648+ AI APIs.
- Includes easy setup instructions, pricing details, and example usage for both curl and Python.
- Highlights alternative models and quality/pricing guidance for users.
